title: CrossChain Scheduler
tagline: CrossChain Scheduler: Revolutionizing DeFi Automation Across Blockchains
description:
Overview:

CrossChain Scheduler is a groundbreaking dApp and protocol that empowers users to automate complex, multi-step DeFi strategies across multiple blockchains. By leveraging LayerZero's cutting-edge cross-chain messaging technology, our platform opens up a new world of possibilities for traders, investors, and DeFi enthusiasts.


Features:

- Cross-chain task creation and execution
- Condition-based triggers (e.g., price thresholds, time-based events)
- Multi-step transaction sequences
- Decentralized solver network for reliable execution
- Seamless integration with popular DeFi protocols

Use Cases:

- Automated profit-taking and stop-loss strategies
- Cross-chain arbitrage opportunities
- Complex leveraged trading positions
- Time-delayed transactions for optimal gas prices
- Collateral management across lending platforms
how_its_made:
Smart Contracts:

-Solidity-based contracts deployed on multiple EVM-compatible chains
-Integration with LayerZero endpoints for cross-chain messaging
-Task creation and management contracts

Backend Infrastructure:

- Solver backend built with Node.js for efficient event processing

Frontend dApp:

- React-based web application
- Integration with backend solver and smart contracts


Cross-Chain Communication:

- Utilization of LayerZero for secure message passing and cros-chain transfers

Swaps:

- Uniswap pool with custom test tokens
